notes: §2002:11.6.3 GR3 forbids only the override of a FINAL method: at --std 2002 a subclass inherits the FINAL M1 and overrides the non-FINAL M2 (A-M1, B-M2 as derived), and an override of a FINAL method is refused (COBOL0839, §2002:11.6.2 SR3; g2002-gr-11-6-3-3-final-method-overridden). Multiple-inheritance subclasses are refused wholesale by COBOL0849 (defect D1, counted at 2002-SR-11.2.2-6).
